Ecclesiastes 1:1: The words of Ecclesiastes, son of David, king of Israel in Jerusalem.
Ecclesiastes 1:12: I, Ecclesiastes, became king over Israel in Jerusalem.
Ecclesiastes 1:13: I set my heart to seek out and examine by wisdom everything that happens beneath heaven, for God gave human beings a grievous distraction to be distracted by.
Ecclesiastes 1:14: I saw all the works done beneath the sun, and behold, everything is futility and resolve of spirit.
Ecclesiastes 1:15: What is twisted cannot be put in order, and what is lacking cannot be counted.
Ecclesiastes 1:16: I spoke in my heart, saying: Behold, I became great and added wisdom beyond everyone who was in Jerusalem before me, and my heart saw much—wisdom and knowledge.
Ecclesiastes 1:17: I set my heart to know wisdom and knowledge; I came to know comparisons and understanding, for this too is resolve of spirit.
Ecclesiastes 1:18: For in much wisdom is much knowledge, and whoever increases knowledge will increase pain.
Numbers 11:16: And the Lord said unto Moses: Gather unto Me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom you yourself know to be elders of the people and their scribes; and you shall bring them unto the Tent of Testimony, and they shall stand there with you.
Numbers 11:17: And I will come down and speak there with you, and will take of the Spirit that is upon you and put it upon them; and they shall help you bear the onrush of the people, and you shall not bear them alone.
